name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.110.0 — The release stage's e2e leg now reds on an unobserved run — an observed zero executed count, or a declared count format that never matched — and the journeys leg reds when zero journeys were walked; the count parsers plus the unobserved predicate now live in one shared module that both review-legs.js and release-legs.js import instead of each declaring their own. 7.109.0 — the default test-classification glob set is single-sourced: `lib/host-config.js`'s `DEFAULT_TEST_GLOBS` is now the sole declaration and is frozen, with `scope-reconcile.js` (main at-risk derivation + `--probe-at-risk`) and `init-gen.js`'s applicability probe importing it instead of re-declaring identical literals; `init-gen.js`'s copy had never been inside the AC-20260906-01-8 equality pin at all. That pin is inverted from two-copy equality to single-sourcing — it walks spec/scripts/ and reddens on ANY second declaration — which retires the AC's source-read equality clause (docs/adr/0011; its host-declared-testGlobs clause is unchanged and still covered). No behaviour change: the literals were verified byte-identical and every read site is a membership test. Re-published under this version after a concurrent session claimed 7.107.0 for an unrelated test-file split. 7.108.0 — genesis BRIEF drops its `design/tokens.css` precondition and its composed-but-unpicked `## Dissents` check — the theme pick moved to /spec:sketch, which runs after genesis, so neither artifact exists when BRIEF runs; the not-yet-approved `next:` line and its doctrine twin stop enumerating the mocks chain, naming APPROVED instead [no-ac: review's version-bump check is the oracle].
